reason: I'd maybe try the free tricks from a TikTok video, but typing my card into some app's website instead of the App Store or Google Play? No. If it's not in the store, I don't pay for it.
objection: Paying by card on an unknown website for an app installed from the browser feels sketchy, and I'm not sure my friends won't see right through the trick anyway.
would_change_my_mind: If it were in the App Store or Google Play with real reviews, and the free tricks actually fooled my friends at a party.
